slash_ground_e.note: Ground slash uses player-scale X4 brace and attack poses; the direction-locked runtime arc supplies the saber silhouette.

slash_ground_ne.note: Rising slash stays on the same player-scale X4 silhouette instead of the oversized Command Mission extraction.

slash_ground_n.note: Vertical slash uses compact lift, apex, attack, and recovery poses aligned to the directional runtime arc.

slash_ground_se.note: Descending slash uses compact brace and attack poses without changing player scale.

slash_ground_s.note: Down slash uses crouch-to-attack X4 poses so the body remains compact and grounded.

slash_air_e.note: Air slash uses player-scale jump and airborne attack poses with the runtime saber arc.

slash_air_ne.note: Rising air slash retains a consistent X4 body scale and clear ascent.

slash_air_n.note: Vertical air slash uses compact ascent and apex poses; the arc communicates the blade direction.

slash_air_se.note: Descending air slash keeps the player-scale X4 airborne silhouette through recovery.

slash_air_s.note: Down air slash uses compact airborne attack and fall poses while the arc supplies the steep cut.
